introHtml: For workers who need extra room without sacrificing durability, custom 4X large coveralls overalls provide the fit and flexibility required for demanding jobs. Whether you're outfitting a construction crew or a manufacturing team, these oversized coveralls accommodate layers and movement. Choose from heavy-duty cotton or poly-cotton blends, and add your logo with screen printing or embroidery. Perfect for safety managers seeking consistent branding across all sizes.
